forest-green.$description: Forest Green — Primary CTA fill, brand accent, star glyph in wordmark, active states — a single chromatic note anchoring an otherwise achromatic interface

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary body and UI text, icon strokes, default border outlines

soft-gray.$description: Soft Gray — Page canvas and section backgrounds — warm off-white that makes white cards feel layered rather than floating

warm-gray.$description: Warm Gray — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, list dividers, de-emphasized links

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — Card and component borders, subtle dividers between sections and list items

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, button text, input fills — the elevated surface above the gray canvas

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Heading text, dark secondary action fill (App Store button), heavy borders on featured headings

inter.$description: All functional UI — body copy, buttons, navigation, inputs, captions, feature descriptions, hero subtext

libre-baskerville.$description: Reserved exclusively for section and page headings — the serif is the editorial signal that separates display from interface
